item.title: GTA 6 Release Date: The Final Countdown to November 19
item.description:
The countdown is on: GTA 6 launches on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. In this episode: what Rockstar has confirmed, the pre-load situation (live since 10 November, reported at up to ~212 GB), the 30fps targeting question, and your launch-week checklist.

Read the full guides on AboutGTA:

GTA 6 release time by region: https://aboutgta.com/gta-6-release-time/
More GTA 6 news and guides: https://aboutgta.com/

item.title: GTA 6 Price Guide: Standard vs Ultimate Edition Explained
item.description:
How much does GTA 6 cost? Rockstar confirmed US pricing on 24 June 2026: the Standard edition is $79.99 and the Ultimate edition is $99.99. In this episode: what the $20 difference means, why there is no cheaper last-gen edition, and why the physical-edition reports need care.

Read the full guides on AboutGTA:
GTA 6 price guide: https://aboutgta.com/news-hub/gta-6-price-guide/
More GTA 6 news and guides: https://aboutgta.com/

item.title: GTA 6 Festival Miami: Lineup, Tickets and the Waitlist
item.description:
Two days after launch, Rockstar and PlayStation present the GTA 6 Festival: one night at Mana Wynwood, Miami, on Saturday 21 November 2026, with Travis Scott, Cardi B, Don Toliver and Kodak Black. In this episode: how the Laylo lottery and DICE sale worked (lottery now closed), the DICE waitlist, and why anyone selling purchase codes is running a scam.
